name: Ruins of Andorhal
summary: In the Western Plaguelands, Andorhal’s ruined streets belong to the Scourge. Once northern Lordaeron’s grain hub, the town now teems with undead abominations, ghouls, and wraiths under Araj the Summoner.

sections.title: Heart of the Plague
sections.body: Andorhal packed the Cult of the Damned’s tainted grain and sent it across the human kingdom. That grain began Lordaeron’s plague of undeath. Now the ruined city is a Scourge stronghold in the Western Plaguelands. Araj the Summoner holds its center, surrounded by ghouls, skeletal horrors, and towering flesh golems. Scarlet Crusade scouting parties sometimes probe the outskirts, but the Scourge rules the shattered streets.

sections.title: Unraveling Time
sections.body: Strange disturbances in time trouble Andorhal alongside its undead host. The town hall clock and pocket watches scattered through the streets all stopped at three o’clock. Chromie, a bronze dragon, shelters in the inn at the ruins’ edge while she investigates temporal parasites nesting in the grain silos. Scourge forces seem to be tampering with time, hoping to alter the course of the city’s tragic fall.

faq.q: Who rules the Ruins of Andorhal?
faq.answer: Araj the Summoner rules the Ruins of Andorhal and directs Scourge activity there. The powerful lich dwells in the city center, guarded by skeletal warriors and flesh constructs.

faq.q: Why is Chromie inside the ruins?
aliases: what is chromie doing in andorhal
faq.answer: Chromie, disguised as a female gnome, investigates unnatural disturbances in time. She suspects something is happening around the city silos and asks travelers to help investigate.

faq.q: Why are all the clocks stopped at three o'clock?
faq.answer: The town hall clock and personal watches found among the ruins stopped at three o’clock. They may be tied to Andorhal’s disturbances in time, but the cause remains unknown.

faq.q: Why does the Scarlet Crusade attack Andorhal?
faq.answer: Scarlet Crusade strike teams try to enter the city and reclaim Lordaeron from the Scourge. The fanatical crusaders send Scarlet Medics, Hunters, and Invokers, but rarely reach the fortified center.

angles.text: As a paladin of the Alliance, you see Andorhal as consecrated ground turned nightmare. The plague poisoned Lordaeron’s grain stores here and doomed the northern kingdom.
As a Forsaken traveler, you may remember the ruined city grimly. Many who walk the Undercity today were citizens of Lordaeron who first swallowed poisoned grain harvested from these fields.
